item.title: Key Future-Ready Qualifications to Kickstart a Career in Tech
item.summary: These days, there are a number of different pathways into the tech industry, depending on what interests you and where you’d like to end up. If you’re leaving school, switching careers, or simply looking for a job that’s more future-proof, the right qualification can help you build practical skills and make your resume stand out [...] The post Key Future-Ready Qualifications to Kickstart a Career in Tech appeared first on Tech Guide .
